notable.note: The most clinically exposed call in the batch. The prospect disclosed an unexplained neurological event that left him hospitalised and paralysed for three days eight months earlier, ongoing left-side weakness he actively protects, prior shoulder surgery, and current neurologist involvement — and was sold six months of loaded kettlebell training and told to start with a 16kg bell, with nobody at any point asking whether a doctor had cleared him to train. The rep additionally told him to stop a prescribed GLP-1 and steered him away from TRT for a documented testosterone of 272. Commercially the call was far better run than the earlier one in the same file: price was held at $6,000 and the split carried no uplift. The 30-day versus three-month ambiguity on the second payment should be corrected in writing before it becomes a dispute.
